name: SupplyOne Plastics, Inc.
old_description: SupplyOne specializes in meeting your complete packaging and shipping needs. Along with providing a wide selection of hand and machine strapping in steel, polyester, and polypropylene, we also stock a range of strapping machines.
about:
SupplyOne Plastics, Inc. was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Reading, Pennsylvania. The company operates as both a packaging manufacturer and a national distributor, providing local service across the United States.

The company manufactures corrugated packaging and offers digital printing, food packaging development, packaging automation, kitting and fulfillment, and vendor-managed inventory programs. It also provides structural and graphic design, packaging use assessments, inventory management, price protection, vendor consolidation, equipment service programs, e-commerce solutions, electronic summary billing, energy reduction services, just-in-time delivery, project management, on-site services, custom barcoding, packaging fulfillment, and custom online catalogs.

SupplyOne serves food and beverage processors — including meat, poultry, and fish packers — as well as industrial manufacturers, middle-market and family-owned businesses, e-commerce operations, and retail brands. Its food packaging specialists work with fresh, frozen, processed, and ready-to-eat products.

The company differentiates itself with a written guaranteed-savings promise, a focus on reducing total cost of ownership, Certified Packaging Professionals who conduct comprehensive assessments, and a nationwide network that delivers unparalleled local service.
built_on: Just-in-time delivery and quick turnaround on custom orders
type_evidence: SupplyOne is both a packaging manufacturer and distributor, providing unparalleled local service nationwide.
